title: Fix shoppingassistant demo
author: olivi-eh
body:
This PR fixes a few issues with the shopping assistant demo and tweaks some of the instruction steps for added clarity.

### How to review
- Look at the script and source code changes for any errors or feedback
- Look at the revised README, staged here, for any errors or feedback: https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo/blob/8292bb57f4222468bc371708fee18894a509ba34/kustomize/components/shopping-assistant/README.md
